about.missionText: From set design to artistic editing, Kinnov'art puts its five crafts to work for creative youth across Guinea.
about.missionBody: Since our creation, we have been committed to providing a space where creativity can flourish. Our workshop located in Nongo, opposite the Bilal Mansour Fadiga Mosque, has become a hub for artists, designers, and creators from across Guinea.

aboutContent.historyP1: Founded in 2020 in the heart of Nongo, Kinnov'art grew out of a shared passion for local craftsmanship and digital innovation. What started as a small carpentry workshop quickly became a multidisciplinary creative centre.
aboutContent.historyP2: Over the years we broadened our horizons to include audiovisual production, artist management and events, becoming a pillar of Conakry's cultural scene.
aboutContent.missionP: Our mission is twofold: to showcase Guinean craftsmanship through modern creations, and to give young talent a platform for expression.
aboutContent.missionInnovationText: Push the boundaries of local creation.
aboutContent.missionTrainingText: Pass skills on to the next generation.
aboutContent.missionCollaborationText: Build synergies between artists from every background.
aboutContent.teamIntro: A passionate, diverse team united by a shared will to create and innovate.
